Homemade vigilante costume.name: Homemade vigilante costume
Homemade vigilante costume.description: A costume pieced together from sports padding, a hooded jacket and a mask, with tape where the seams have given out. It blunts punches and scrapes but stops no blade, and fighting crime in it without a hero license is vigilantism, an arrestable offense. [ Armor | About ¥15,000 in parts ]
